title: silene vulgaris subsp. prostrata
intro: Silene vulgaris subsp. prostrata, commonly known as creeping catchfly or spreading catchfly, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene vulgaris subsp. prostrata include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
